'''Vinn Atrius''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] living during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
[[File:Vaylin_the_Last_Empress_of_Zakuul.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Like all Horizon Guards, Atrius was hand-picked by Empress Vaylin.]]
A member of the [[Knights of Zakuul]] at the time of the [[war against Zakuul]], Atrius was hand-picked by Empress [[Vaylin]] to join the new [[Horizon Guard]] following her Coronation.<ref name="Codex" /> After Vaylin was [[Assault on Odessen|killed]] and Zakuulan Empire [[Battle of Zakuul|toppled]] by the [[Eternal Alliance]], he witnessed the plight of his people and the heavy toll of war, beginning to resent the Alliance and its [[Alliance Commander|Commander]], who brought an end to Zakuul's centuries of prosperity. Determined to destroy the Alliance by using [[Zildrog]], an ancient [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] from [[Iokath]], Atrius set up base of operations on an [[Abandoned listening post|Abandoned Listening Post]] and began seeking allies to join his secret [[Order of Zildrog]].<ref name="Nathema" />

[[File:GEMINI_16_and_Vinn_Atrius.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Vinn Atrius with GEMINI 16]]
Not knowing how to activate Zildrog or how to control it, Atrius searched the [[GEMINI]] network and eventually was approached by [[GEMINI 16]], a rogue unit who sought the total destruction of the [[Eternal Fleet]]. GEMINI 16 acquired access to the security of [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]], allowing the Order to observe the Alliance's every step for months. Atrius was also approached by one of the Alliance's original founders [[Theron Shan]], who now wanted to join the Order and bring the Alliance down. Atrius initially refused to listen to him, which led Theron to arrange a [[War on Iokath|trap]] for the Alliance Commander on [[Iokath]] and later [[Crisis on Umbara|steal]] a shipment of [[Adegan crystal/Legends|adegan crystals]] on [[Umbara]] to win Atrius' trust and be allowed to join the Order. GEMINI 16 warned Atrius that Shan should not be trusted,<ref name="Nathema" /> but Theron proved himself extremely useful, infiltrating the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Inrokini family|House Inrokini]] on [[Copero/Legends|Copero]] to obtain the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]] to Zildrog's location.<ref name="Copero">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|A Traitor Among the Chiss}}</ref>

The coordinates pointed to [[Nathema]] and the Order moved its base of operations there, taking everything they could from the [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] with them and tasking Shan with wiping all data and destroying the rest. Arriving on Nathema, Atrius, Shan and GEMINI 16 located Zildrog in the ruins of an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] temple and began the ritual meant to awaken it, assisted by their allies who had personal vendettas against the Alliance Commander. However, Theron Shan was acting as a double-agent for the Alliance the whole time, and managed to warn them of the Order's intentions, leading [[Lana Beniko]] the Alliance Commander straight to Nathema, where he joined them. After GEMINI 16 informed him about Theron's true allegiance, Vinn Atrius ordered to begin awakening Zildrog ahead of schedule, and the GEMINI deceived and betrayed many of their allies, locking them inside energy transfer chambers to be used as fuel for Zildrog's awakening.<ref name="Nathema" /> 

[[File:Vinn_Atrius_confronts.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Vinn Atrius confronts the Commander and Lana Beniko.]]
Shan, Beniko and the Commander [[Mission to Nathema (Zildrog)|interrupted the ritual]] and Shan shot Atrius, but GEMINI 16 had already awakened Zildrog and ordered it to use the ''[[Gravestone]]'' to attack the Eternal Fleet in orbit of Odessen. The trio engaged and destroyed the GEMINI, but by that time the Eternal Fleet was completely destroyed and Zildrog was already targeting Odessen itself. Shan attempted to disable Zildrog, but Atrius stabbed him in the back with his [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pike]] and ordered Zildrog to augment him with his power. Zildrog increased his strength and Atrius engaged the Commander and Beniko, who defeated him and destroyed Zildrog. Laying at the mercy of the one he worked so hard to destroy, Atrius then tried to taunt the Commander into ending his life.<ref name="Nathema" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Vinn_Atrius_armor_closeup.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Vinn Atrius in his armor]]
The player has the options to either imprison Atrius or send him back to Zakuul to be dealt with by his own people for Light Side points, or kill him on the spot for Dark Side points.<ref name="Nathema" />
